caption:
"I don't have time to learn another system."

That's the real objection under most automation conversations. Fair one. Nobody wants to become IT support for their own shop.

Here's what costs you time right now: a team calling a lead once, waiting, forgetting to follow up, chasing quotes by hand. That's the cost you're already paying, every day, whether you notice it or not.

A real system flips that. You turn on one automation, missed-call text-back, and it runs on its own from there. No daily babysitting required.

This week: turn on just that one. Add the next automation once it's running clean.

rationale: Carousels are leading engagement and saves for B2B educational content in 2026 benchmarks, and this fills the under-served Objection Handling slot with an unclaimed angle (time/complexity fear) distinct from the cost, impersonal, timing, and tried-and-failed objections already shipped.
